modifications: no free model with separate, named structures was found: NIH 3D's "Animal Cell" is CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial, excluded), other cell models are paid marketplace models (CGTrader, 3DCadBrowser, Free3D royalty-free) or physical teaching models; so the model is authored by the pipeline script
three.js geometry extending the procedural animal cell of the approved Bilig Workbench prototype (bilig_ft plugin-gltf cells.ts)
named nodes for the topic's masks: Membrane, Cytoplasm, Nucleus (+ Nucleolus, pores, chromatin), Mito_1…4 (cristae), Ribo_1 (on rough ER), Ribo_2 (free), Golgi (cisternae + vesicles)
decorative, unnamed: rough and smooth ER, lysosomes, a centriole pair
organelles placed on the topic's concept anchors; colours from the concept hues (hsl(h, 62%, 62%))
gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation; KHR_materials_clearcoat
